spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    "Timestamp" AS "time",
    "PatchTitle" AS "text",
    CONCAT_WS (
        ', ',
        CASE WHEN "IsPatch" THEN 'Patch' END,
        CASE WHEN "IsHotfix" THEN 'Hotfix' END,
        CASE WHEN "IsFreeContent" THEN 'Free Content' END,
        CASE WHEN "IsPaidContent" THEN 'Paid Content' END
    ) AS "tags"
FROM "Build"
WHERE $__timeFilter("Timestamp")
    AND (
        "IsPatch"
        OR "IsHotfix"
        OR "IsFreeContent"
        OR "IsPaidContent"
    )
    AND (
        '${Topic:raw}' = '__all'
        OR (
            'IsTopicAi' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
            AND "IsTopicAi"

        OR (
            'IsTopicBugs' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )

SELECT
    "DateTime" AS "time",
    "DateTimeEnd" AS "timeend",
    CONCAT (
        "DiscountTitle",
        ' | Final Price: $',
        TO_CHAR ( "FinalPrice", 'FM999999990.00' )
    ) AS "text"
FROM "Discount"
WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime")
ORDER BY "DateTime";

                'IsTopicContent' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
                AND "IsTopicContent"
            )
            OR (
                'IsTopicMultiplayer' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
                AND "IsTopicMultiplayer"
            )
            OR (
                'IsTopicUi' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
                AND "IsTopicUi"
            )
            OR (
                'IsTopicGraphics' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
                AND "IsTopicGraphics"
            )
            OR (
                'IsTopicAudio' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
                AND "IsTopicAudio"
            )
            OR (
                'IsTopicMods' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
                AND "IsTopicMods"
            )
            OR (
                'IsTopicDifficulty' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
                AND "IsTopicDifficulty"
            )
            OR (
                'IsTopicUpdate' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
                AND "IsTopicUpdate"
            )
            OR (
                'IsTopicDeveloper' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
                AND "IsTopicDeveloper"
            )
            OR (
                'IsTopicMonetization' = ANY ( string_to_array ( '${Topic:raw}', ',' ) )
                AND "IsTopicMonetization"
            )
        )
),
"ReviewWindow" AS (
    SELECT
        build."BuildId",
        build."Date",
        build."PatchTitle",
        build."ReleaseType",
        AVG (
            CASE
                WHEN review."Date" BETWEEN build."Date" - 7 AND build."Date" - 1
                THEN CASE WHEN review."IsVotedUp" THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
            END
        ) AS "Past7DayPositiveReviewAverage",
        AVG (
            CASE
                WHEN review."Date" BETWEEN build."Date" AND build."Date" + 6
                THEN CASE WHEN review."IsVotedUp" THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
            END
        ) AS "Next7DayPositiveReviewAverage"
    FROM "BuildAnnouncement" build
    LEFT JOIN "FilteredReview" review
        ON review."Date" BETWEEN build."Date" - 7 AND build."Date" + 6
    GROUP BY
        build."BuildId",
        build."Date",
        build."PatchTitle",
        build."ReleaseType"
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR ( "Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS "Date",
    "PatchTitle",
    "ReleaseType",
    "Past7DayPositiveReviewAverage",
    "Next7DayPositiveReviewAverage",
    (
        "Next7DayPositiveReviewAverage"
        - "Past7DayPositiveReviewAverage"
    ) / NULLIF ( "Past7DayPositiveReviewAverage", 0 )
        AS "7DayPositiveReviewAverageReturn"
FROM "ReviewWindow"
ORDER BY "Date" DESC;
